<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/auth/logout"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Ends the session the request's token belongs to: the token, and every
media token minted with it, stop working immediately, even if a copy
survives on the device. Clients call it before forgetting the token.
With a personal access token, or a session token issued before
server-side sessions existed, there is no session to end and it just
returns `200`. Server feature `sessions`.
